description: This file contains unit tests for the RetrieveAttributeStrategy class, which is part of the command strategy pattern for retrieving attributes in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The tests verify immutability, retrieval of existing attributes, and proper error handling for missing or non-existing attributes.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RetrieveAttributeStrategy, testing immutability and attribute retrieval behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RetrieveAttributeStrategy before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that RetrieveAttributeStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: retrieveExistingAttribute
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an existing attribute from the thing.

methods.name: retrieveAttributeFromThingWithoutAttributes
methods.description: Tests behavior when retrieving an attribute from a thing without any attributes, expecting an exception.

methods.name: retrieveNonExistingAttribute
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a non-existent attribute, expecting an attribute not found exception.
